records.inherited_baseline: 明代长期沿用大统历，西方近代天文学尚未形成同等系统的国家知识产品。
records.attributable_change: 1629年批准改历并设历局，徐光启、李天经与欧洲传教士系统翻译、编纂天文学与数学知识，1634年完成137卷《崇祯历书》；虽未在明代正式颁历，但成果完整存续并被清初直接采用。
records.field_coverage: 天文学理论、数学、仪器、观测和历法计算的系统跨文化转化。
records.durability_and_handoff: 完整成果由清初直接整理颁行，形成长期天文学基线。
records.cross_scene_replication: 理论翻译、数学方法、仪器、实测与历法编纂多个专业场景。

counterevidence.summary: 技术作者是徐光启等专家，明亡前新历未正式颁行，因此压在CIV3-LOW。

source_refs: 故宫博物院《崇祯历书》词条

records.inherited_baseline: 明初已有前代和洪武地理资料，但缺少景泰朝这种覆盖全国现行行政区划的完成态官修总志。
records.attributable_change: 景泰五年派二十九名进士分赴各地搜集舆地资料，并命陈循、高谷、王文等总裁；景泰七年完成119卷《寰宇通志》，以两京十三布政司和府州县为纲，系统整理建置、山川、风俗、学校、科甲等国家地理知识。
records.field_coverage: 全国舆地、行政沿革、学校科甲、风俗物产等多门地理知识。
records.durability_and_handoff: 成书本身完成且短期使用，但天顺朝迅速重修并毁版，明显限制稳定交班。
records.cross_scene_replication: 全国采访与中央汇编两个层级。

counterevidence.summary: 《寰宇通志》大量利用既有地理总志和明初方志，并在英宗复位后很快被重修、毁版；未形成长期稳定版本传统。因此取CIV2-HIGH而非R3。

records.inherited_baseline: 晚明已有耶稣会知识交流传统，但南明流亡朝廷此前没有同等密集的宫廷传教和官方赴欧知识外交网络。
records.attributable_change: 永历朝允许瞿安德、卜弥格等耶稣会士长期进入宫廷活动，皇太后、皇后、太子及宫人多人受洗；朝廷又正式委派卜弥格赴欧洲，以南明使节身份携国书往罗马。卜弥格由此把中国地理、植物、医学和宗教资料系统带入欧洲早期汉学网络。
records.field_coverage: 永历宫廷天主教网络、耶稣会士、中国知识西传和赴欧使节链。
records.durability_and_handoff: 卜弥格的报告、地图、植物和医学资料进入欧洲知识网络，具有跨政权的后续传播。
records.cross_scene_replication: 宫廷传教、王室受洗、赴欧使节和中国知识西传多个相关场景。

counterevidence.summary: 永历帝本人并未明确受洗；后妃皈依和知识著述主要由瞿安德、庞天寿、卜弥格等推动；传教社会覆盖又主要限宫廷。故取CIV2-MID，不进R3。

records.inherited_baseline: 明初皇帝死亡时仍存在强迫部分宫妃殉葬的制度性生命与身份风险
records.contemporary_feasible_frontier: 皇帝可以通过遗诏取消宫妃殉葬，并由继任者延续为宫廷规范
records.background_trend: 明代人殉已存在批评压力，但英宗遗诏是明确终止宫妃殉葬并形成后续惯例的可归责行动
records.attributable_change: 天顺八年临终遗诏明确停止宫妃殉葬，使宫廷女性不再因皇帝死亡而被制度性要求殉死；此后明代皇帝基本不再以宫妃殉葬，形成稳定交班
records.field_coverage: palace consorts, a narrow social group but facing an extreme institutional life-status harm
records.durability_and_handoff: the abolition became a durable Ming court norm under successors

counterevidence.summary: the affected group was narrow and this does not imply a broad improvement in women's status, so the band stays LOW

records.inherited_baseline: large bodies of dispersed texts existed without a completed single state compilation
records.attributable_change: 长期征集四方文士生员、文渊阁开馆并由国家供膳，完成二万二千九百三十七卷、一万一千九十五册大型知识汇编；永乐正本仅一套且深藏内府，嘉靖朝才另行重录副本，保存价值巨大但当期可复制性与可及性极低
records.field_coverage: very large compilation and preservation across many knowledge categories, with only one Yongle manuscript set and extremely narrow contemporary access
records.durability_and_handoff: the corpus preserved otherwise vulnerable texts and later enabled recoveries, but a single palace manuscript created severe survival and use constraints

counterevidence.summary: only one Yongle manuscript set existed and it was not printed; scale therefore cannot be treated as broad knowledge access

records.inherited_baseline: the court lacked the same sustained state-organized Indian Ocean contact and resulting travel texts
records.attributable_change: 国家组织远洋航行形成持续跨区域接触与地理、物产、航路知识输入；随行者记录最终形成域外知识文本
records.field_coverage: maritime geography, routes, products, and foreign-polity knowledge from repeated voyages and participant texts

records.inherited_baseline: Jianwen-era scholar-official networks retained greater personal and intellectual safety before the post-coup purge
records.contemporary_feasible_frontier: political consolidation did not require treating a major scholar and his associated network as a broad intellectual punishment target
records.background_trend: the civil-war transition created political risk, but the scale and symbolic targeting of the Fang Xiaoru case were ruler-window choices
records.attributable_change: 方孝孺作为当时重要学者因拒绝为新政权起草即位诏书被处死，并牵连大批相关人员；不采用后世“诛十族”传说，只消费可闭合的人才损失和学术表达安全恶化
records.field_coverage: one major scholar-official and a substantial associated political-intellectual network; no claim of realm-wide book destruction
records.durability_and_handoff: the executions were irreversible and created a clear elite expression-safety signal, but system-wide downstream closure is not quantified

counterevidence.summary: the popular 'ten clans' claim is excluded as later legend; the package is kept at R1 rather than inflated

records.inherited_baseline: 永乐、成化以来宫廷已有藏传佛教传统，武宗接手的并非空白场域。
records.attributable_change: 正德朝武宗持续学习番语、密切接纳藏僧并自号‘大庆法王’，在豹房建立藏传佛教寺院和仪轨活动，制作带汉藏双语题记的皇家宗教艺术品，并长期维持北京—乌斯藏宗教文化交流节点。
records.field_coverage: 藏僧、番语实践、藏传佛教仪轨、宫廷寺院和双语宗教艺术。
records.durability_and_handoff: 正德朝形成一段高度个人化但持续多年的汉藏宫廷文化节点；嘉靖初迅速撤销，限制更高档。
records.cross_scene_replication: 番语学习、自号法王、藏僧网络、豹房寺院与双语艺术多个相关场景。

counterevidence.summary: 主要集中宫廷，没有闭合新的大型译经、学校或公共传播体系；此前明廷已有强藏传佛教基线。豹房巨额财政成本属于第二项财政，不在C轴重复扣分。因此取CIV1-HIGH。

records.inherited_baseline: late Yuan warfare left disrupted school supply and no operating Ming-wide education-exam pipeline
records.contemporary_feasible_frontier: printing and centralized prefectural-county administration allowed a broad network, but realized operation rather than nominal institutions controls credit
records.background_trend: postwar recovery aided demand; school openings, tribute-student movement, and recurring examinations were attributable state actions
records.attributable_change: 建立府州县、卫所学校与国子监供给框架，并使地方贡生进入中央教育通道；恢复乡试、会试和殿试的周期性选拔，使教育与入仕形成可运行管道
records.field_coverage: operating central, prefectural-county, and garrison school channels plus recurring examination and tribute-student movement
records.durability_and_handoff: the founding framework continued, but later expansion is not assigned back to the founder

records.inherited_baseline: learners and local schools retained greater autonomy from corporal punishment and criminally enforced recitation
records.contemporary_feasible_frontier: mature printing enabled broad text distribution, but criminal compulsion and institutional punishment were attributable
records.background_trend: the school network and coercive orders were ruler-directed
records.attributable_change: 国子监以体罚、发遣和禁锢约束学习讨论；《大诰》又进入学宫、里塾并以刑罚强制背读，扩大单一文本接触的同时形成广域教育强制
records.field_coverage: central academy discipline plus realm-level school and village-school forced reading of the Great Declarations
records.durability_and_handoff: the coercive education rules operated across the ruler window and shaped school use

records.inherited_baseline: wrongly registered civilians and implicated family members remained trapped in military status
records.attributable_change: 清军核验纠正冒籍、抑配并释放受株累良民
records.field_coverage: verified false-registration and collective-implication cases, not the whole military-household order

records.inherited_baseline: 洪武后期科举已恢复并稳定运行，建文帝接手的并非教育或选士空白。
records.attributable_change: 建文朝在既有科举之外，下诏荐举优通文学之士并实际授官，形成一个面向文学士人的补充人才入口；同时整体提高文臣政治地位，但后者属于第二项，不在B轴重复计分。
records.field_coverage: 科举之外的文学荐举与实际授官入口。

counterevidence.summary: 主要是对成熟明代选士体系的补充，具体覆盖人数有限且在位仅四年；不把‘尊重文教’的整体声誉机械转化为高分，因此只取CIV1-LOW。

records.inherited_baseline: 西方知识此前主要限于澳门和南方少数据点，尚无稳定北京活动和朝廷保护节点。
records.attributable_change: 1601年利玛窦入京后，万历拒绝礼部赏遣意见，准其长期留京并提供物质保障；随后形成徐光启、李之藻等参与的持续中西数学、地理知识翻译网络。
records.field_coverage: 北京宫廷—士人中西知识交流、数学与地理翻译。
records.durability_and_handoff: 保护环境持续十余年并产生《几何原本》等成果。

counterevidence.summary: 科学创作主体是利玛窦、徐光启等，皇帝只消费许可和保护。

records.inherited_baseline: 利玛窦之后中西知识网络在北京、南京持续运作。
records.attributable_change: 1616年底最终批准驱逐外国教士，南京与北京主要传教—知识节点被迫撤离，造成已经存在的跨文化科学和宗教知识网络实际中断。
records.field_coverage: 数学、历法等知识携带者及跨文化交流节点被逐。

counterevidence.summary: 初期地方官先行、皇帝曾留中；压制未永久结束，天启后再度使用西方专家，故保持R2。

records.inherited_baseline: 嘉靖前期王阳明、湛若水学派及其书院讲学网络已经形成并迅速扩张。
records.contemporary_feasible_frontier: 朝廷可以不资助书院，但无需以学派异说和聚徒为由直接禁毁已有学术网络。
records.background_trend: 心学传播具有强社会自发性；嘉靖十六、十七年的禁毁属于明确政治—学术压制。
records.attributable_change: 嘉靖十六年首先毁闭王、湛相关书院，次年扩大禁止书院和聚徒讲学，直接压缩已形成的学术组织与表达空间；但社会网络反弹强，民间继续办学，未形成长期全面断裂。
records.field_coverage: 王学、湛学书院及更广讲学网络，覆盖多个地区但执行不彻底。
records.durability_and_handoff: 短期存在实际毁闭与威慑，但书院和心学传播很快以其他形式延续，限制R3。

counterevidence.summary: 禁令未能阻断书院扩张，嘉靖时期书院反而总体繁盛，因此只取R2。

records.inherited_baseline: 晚明东林及各地书院仍是活跃的讲学、学术和公共议论节点。
records.attributable_change: 天启四至六年皇帝拒绝针对魏忠贤的弹劾并持续给予政治保护，随后东林人士发生连续诏狱、削籍和死亡；天启五至六年又奉旨拆毁东林及全国讲学书院，形成士人安全、学术组织和讲学空间的跨场景破坏。
records.field_coverage: 东林士人网络、全国书院讲学空间及学术表达安全。
records.durability_and_handoff: 书院禁毁持续时间较短，1627后迅速逆转；诏狱死亡和短期寒蝉效应不可逆。
records.cross_scene_replication: 诏狱与士人清洗、全国书院拆毁两个独立知识生态破坏场景。

counterevidence.summary: 主要执行由魏忠贤集团推动，且崇祯即位后迅速平反和恢复书院，因此压CIV3-LOW；但人员死亡不可逆。
